bibliographic.title: Altroquando
bibliographic.author: Pinellos
bibliographic.description: A text-game for a contest, the “Marmellata d’Avventura 2018” organized by Old Games Italia Network. It uses a sub-system to handle things like inventory, objects, interactions, map etc… to write adventure games in the style of Lucasart/SCUMM (use-this-to-something gameplay, multiple-choice dialogues with NPC etc…) and avoid the CYOA-paradigm that is typical of the Twine-based games.
